'''Grenade fungi''' were white spherical fungi that grew on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. When stepped on, they exploded in a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] spore cloud.

When a nearly mature [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] dried, it could be used as a [[grenade]]-like explosive.<ref name="GG2" />

==Biology and Appearance==
Young grenade fungi is subterranean, appearing as no more than a slight rise or bulge in a layer of dead leafmold. As the fungus matures, it breaks through the leafmold, puffs out to nearly half a meter in diameter and develops its characteristic gray-blue scales. Often arcs or complete rings of nearly mature grenade fungi break through the forest floor at the same time, indicating the spore brethren of a centrally located parent fungus. As the fungi mature, they develop a hard, almost brittle, globular white outer shell.<ref name="GG2" />

The sensitive shell can be broken by a disturbance as subtle as a delicate wind. When broken, the shell bursts with a loud bang and showers thousands of spores in all directions. Sometimes the concussion of the first burst is enough to set off other nearby grenade fungi, detonating a cloud of spores that are capable of choking small animals not fast enough to outrun it.<ref name="GG2" />

==Habitat==
The grenade fungi is found all across Yavin 4's jungle systems, burrowing up from the thick leafmold present during the dry season.<ref name="GG2" />
